name: n4_find_dangling_outputs
description: List components (up to depth levels below ord) with an 'out' slot that no link in the subtree uses as a source. Links from outside the subtree are not seen. A source ORD that is neither a handle nor an absolute slot path cannot be resolved: outputs it may feed are listed as unknown, not dangling. A component with an alarm or history extension child (alarm:...AlarmExt, history:...HistoryExt) has its out read by that extension without a link: it is listed in consumed_by_extension (with the extension type), not as dangling.

depth.description: Component levels below ord to scan (1-4)
